Container.Name: airtag-map
Container.Overview: Experimentell karta för dina egna AirTags och Hitta-föremål. Välj ditt eget Custom-nätverk och ange containerns adress i Fixed IP address. WebUI använder den valda adressen på port 8787. Ange Apple-inloggningen inne i appen. Bygge och appstart är verifierade; faktisk Apple-åtkomst måste provas med ditt konto.

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: WebUI listens on port 8787. On a Custom network, connect to the container Fixed IP address directly on port 8787.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent Apple sessions, accessory keys and last locations. Protect this directory and backups.

Config.Name: App password
Config.Description: App login password, not your Apple password. Username: admin. Choose a separate random password of at least 12 characters.

Config.Name: Data directory inside container
Config.Description: Keep /data unless also changing the path mapping.

Config.Name: HTTPS-only session cookie
Config.Description: Set 1 when accessing this web app exclusively over HTTPS, for example through Cloudflare Tunnel. Keep 0 for local HTTP access.

Config.Name: Anisette v3 server
Config.Description: Legacy Rust exporter only; the default Linux CoreADI backend does not use this URL.
